$comment: Rule 6: prices are configuration. The length ladder was set 2026-09-30 (docs/decisions.md D15) and replaces the 2026-09-29 numbers in D6. Short names are still NOT sellable: the claim policy rejects every non-free tier until the payment flow exists (`features.premiumPurchase` stays false). The currency is also unsettled — this chain's stablecoin is USDG, not USDC — so nothing here has been charged to anyone.
$comment_units: All length thresholds use limits.lengthMetric (default: display width, so one CJK character counts as two).
$comment_ladder: A name is priced by how few characters it has, because that is what makes it worth remembering. The first name of five characters or more is free — that promise is what the product is built on and it does not change. What costs money is being short, and taking more names than the free one.

additionalName.$comment: Beyond the one free name per wallet, a longer name is one dollar. Not implemented: the claim policy has no notion of a paid extra name yet, and this key is the design that the payment flow will read.
